text_block_list.text:
...So what I'm saying is, I've come to a
realization.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
You're not really free unless you're
paying your
own way.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, you're just living like a sheep
off
someone else's dime! And I ain't no
lamb chop!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I'm heading to a part-time gig, duh! And
you're
coming with me!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Yep! I'm gonna get moolah on the clock.
Pull
myself up by my bootstraps,
y'know?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, Tracen
Academy does
allow part-time work, as
long as the student gets
permission.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Thing is, permission is taking forever. Weird, right? Can't they see how raring to go I am?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
...I'd have reservations about letting her
loose on
the world as well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't go nodding along with that!
Doesn't it
bother you that your student's
getting frozen
out?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm not gonna stand for this!
There's only
one thing for it...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I gotta practice up before I take on the
real thing!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Ding ding ding! Got some hits!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Better screw on your thinking cap, 'cause
it's
decision time!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Your choices are... One: Fantabulous ☆
Physical
Labor with the Dorm Leader! Or
two:
Splendiferous ☆ Yakisoba Noodle
Fry-Up!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Tick, tock... Oh, and if you run out the
clock,
you're in for some Paintastic ☆
Trainer Origami!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! So you've come to help, have
you?
Thanks a million!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It's Ritto Dorm's turn to clean the pool,
but we're
rather shorthanded. You're
lifesavers!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it, young mistress—your
faithful
maid Golshi lives only to serve!
This limescale will
be all gone in a
scrub-scrubbity-scrub!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Erm... That sounds splendid, but... why
are you
talking like that?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Her latest bit aside, Голд Шипп does a
surprisingly
thorough job cleaning the
pool.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All right, dirt! Prepare to meet your
maker!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
What graceful technique! She wields the
brush
like an extension of her arm... No,
her entire body
is one with the brush!
text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Students

text_block_list.text:
You too? What on earth has gotten into
everyone
today?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Phew! I "maid" short work of that
mission!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I'm impressed. Without your help, this
would have
taken twice the time.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I can't offer you money, but still, I'd like
to
reward your efforts somehow.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
For real?! I can have anything I want?
That's what
you said, right?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Not in the slightest!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Hmm-hmm! Let's see...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I've got it! I wanna freeze all the water in
this pool
and make shaved ice out of it!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... That's an amusing idea, but
from a
hygiene perspective, I'm afraid
there would be
issues...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tachyooon! Gimme some of that

insta-freeze powder, and lots of it!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
The perfect partner in crime! ...I mean,
hold it,
Golshi! Stop, I say!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп gathers all the equipment and

ingredients for yakisoba in a flash.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I've come for yakisoba. I hear this place
serves
the good stuff.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
You heard right, my friend! So just one...
no, two
of you today?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Oohhh, dat's one nice-lookin' pan ya got
dere.
And dat stove looks like it could
put out some
real heat!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Naniwa's gutsiest's got a cravin'... I got
high hopes
for dat yakisoba, Golshi!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but I got no words to say to either
of you.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
My frying pan does all the talkin'. That's
the vow I
made when I chose this life five
minutes ago!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп deftly fries up the noodles
like a real
pro!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: OHHH YEEEAAAHHH!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Her form's darn near flawless! Da
way she
flips da noodles... She's steamin'
off all dat excess
water so's dey don't
get soggy!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
...This isn't good, Tama. For the first time
in my
life, I fear... I may drool!
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: Da heck's up wid dis?!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
...Dis here flavor, I can't put it inna
words...
Nothin'll do it justice!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Seconds, please!
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: Heh... Well, maybe dat'll do.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Tamamo, does that mean...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yer legit! Naniwa's soul lives in ya!
The title
of ultimate yakisoba fryin'
Umamusume is all yers!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Tamamo! Thank you so much!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Um... Seconds please...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп takes off with the deck brush,
and Fuji
Kiseki and I gave chase. In the
end, we all
collapse from exhaustion.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шип's yakisoba is so good that all
of life's
little problems seem to melt
away with one bite.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
